candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: Load the candidate demo build — zero public canary traffic; the change removes client-side fallbacks and repoints one fetch path
candidateVerificationJourney.notes: Issue's own Release evidence section: 'with the API reachable, decisions load from the API; with the API blocked, an honest error renders and no fixture content appears.' Transcribed verbatim; no additional surfaces inferred. Per ADR-094 the signed-in path is the live-backed one — the replay entry must issue no /v1/* request at all, which is asserted structurally rather than by a journey.

journeys.name: decisions-load-from-api-when-reachable
assertions: decisions render from GET /v1/demo/decisions, the route that exists — not /v1/demo/recommendations
no recommendationFixtures content appears anywhere on the page

journeys.name: api-blocked-renders-honest-error
assertions: with the API blocked, an error state renders
no fixture content and no captured-scenario content is substituted for the failed fetch
the surface does not look healthy while the backend is unreachable

journeys.name: in-progress-has-no-mock-execution-state
assertions: no startExecution-created record appears; localStorage holds no mock execution state for the Optimize Product path

staticAssetChecks.notes: Issue text: 'assert the removed fixture module is no longer in the built bundle — a deletion that leaves the bytes shipped is not a deletion.' The check reads the built artifact, not the source tree.

migrationCompatibility.notes: Issue text: 'No migration.' Client-side removal in apps/demo only — no database schema, no persisted-shape change.

rollbackAssertion.notes: Issue text: 'reverting restores the mock; assert that is a *visible* regression rather than a silent one, so a rollback is diagnosable.' A rollback that silently returns to fixture-backed content is the failure mode this assertion exists to catch.

doNotInfer: release evidence fields beyond what the issue's Release evidence (ADR-035) section states
removing mock flows for the other ten workflows — this is a scoped removal for the Optimize Product surfaces only, and their tests are the regression net
editing the other ten workflows' tests to accommodate this removal
making the replay entry call /v1/demo/decisions — per ADR-094 the replay path issues no authenticated request
substituting captured-scenario content for a failed signed-in fetch — that is the same silent-health defect in a new costume
deleting the offline state along with the fixture fallback — a genuinely offline client still renders the calm offline state
